_why: Which PRs skip the LCH-600 review gate: the speed program's own work (incidents, LCH-600's children). Review by 2027-02-23: the exemption exists because that work IS the review desk's own backlog, and gating it would loop. `prefixes`: whole Jira projects that stay exempt (a title key or a `<prefix><N>-` branch of that project). `keys`: single tickets exempt by exact key (the LCH-600 epic and its children after the Jira move to project LC, where a project prefix would exempt every LC PR). `HEALTH` = bbm-health-issues incident fixes after the LCH lock, a title starting `HEALTH-<issue#>` or a `health<N>-` branch (LCH-794; ci-speed ruling on board request 363, 2026-11-27). Keep `LCH` until the 2027-02-23 review so in-flight lch branches stay exempt. A key must match whole (LC-23 is not LC-2300). An unreadable or malformed file falls back to prefixes [LCH] only.
_keys: Filled 2026-11-23 (LCH-794) after the Jira move: LCH-600 became LC-2484; these are LC-2484 and its 104 children at move time. A new child of LC-2484 is NOT exempt until added here.
